name: Ahoy!!

boost.name: Yo-Ho-Ho
effect: NOW: Draw 1.
+1 Speed if you initiated this Strike.
HIT: Draw 1. Gain Advantage.
description: 以Marine的招牌招呼語'Ahoy!!'為核心，代表海盜船長的登場宣言。高速輕擊配合抽牌效果，展現她快速說話、帶動氣氛的招牌形象，是整套牌的節奏起點。

name: I'm Your Treasure Box

boost.name: Shine Bright
effect: Add the top card of your deck to your Gauge. Take another action.
BEFORE: You may add 1 card from your hand to your Gauge. If you do, +2 Power.
HIT: Add the top 2 cards of your deck to your Gauge.
description: 取自Marine的代表歌曲'I'm Your Treasure Box'（作曲：Camellia）。圍繞「寶箱」意象設計，擅長積蓄資源（Gauge），展現她作為寶藏獵人收集財寶的形象，也是牌組的資源引擎。

name: I'm Horny

boost.name: Seduction
effect: HIT: The opponent discards 1 random card.
AFTER: If this Strike hit, gain 1 life.
Ignore Armor.
HIT: Pull 1. The opponent discards 1 card of their choice.
description: 由桐生可可教Marine的英文名句，現已成為她的招牌台詞之一。設計上強調「魅惑」與「剝奪」，體現Marine色氣大姊姊（エロ船長）的誘惑力，讓對手失去資源。

name: Yosoro!

boost.name: Full Sail
effect: NOW: Advance or Retreat up to 2.
+1 Power if you moved this turn.
BEFORE: Advance 1.
AFTER: Retreat up to 2. Draw 1 if you retreated.
description: Marine的告別用語'ヨーソロー！'（Yosoro!），源自海盜用語。設計上聚焦於航海般的自由移動能力，能夠靈活推進或後撤，配合抽牌效果體現她操控距離的戰鬥風格。

name: DON!

boost.name: Headpat Rejection
effect: +2 Armor.
NOW: If your opponent is at Range 1, Strike.
CRITICAL: +3 Power.
HIT: The opponent cannot Advance or Retreat until the end of their next turn (Stun 1). Gain Advantage.
description: 粉絲討拍時Marine回應的'DON!'（咚！）聲音效。設計為強力反擊卡，高Guard與Armor讓她能在防守後反擊並暈眩對手，就像她對想討拍的人當頭一喝。

boost.name: Self-Rating
effect: NOW: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may add 1 to your hand.
X is 9 minus the opponent's Speed (minimum 1, maximum 6).
HIT: Gain Advantage.
description: Marine常掛在嘴邊的自我評分'95/100'，代表她對自己充滿自信卻又留餘地的態度。X的計算方式（9-對手速度）象徵她總是給自己打95分的幽默設定，可長可短的射程增加了靈活性。

name: Dokuro-kun

boost.name: Skull Toast
effect: NOW: Spend up to 2 life. Draw that many cards.
+1 Guard for each life spent this way.
BEFORE: Gain 2 life.
HIT: The opponent loses 2 life (life drain). Add this card to your Gauge.
description: ドクロ君——Marine代表性的骷髏造型酒杯，是粉絲間的知名象徵物。設計為生命操控卡，可以燃燒生命換取資源或吸取對手生命，呼應酒杯的飲酒意象與Marine在粉絲間的icon地位。

name: Jack

boost.name: Host Club Mode
effect: +1 Power and +1 Speed.
HIT: Add this card to your Gauge.
Ignore Guard.
BEFORE: Close 2.
HIT: Push 2. Gain Advantage.
description: 三期生Host Club企劃中性轉版的Jack，是Marine另一個人格的體現。此卡代表她帥氣冷靜的一面，消耗1F資源換取強力的破防攻擊，關門壓迫對手後再推開，完美展現Jack瀟灑的風格。

name: Dead Ma'am's Chest

boost.name: Toby's Gift
effect: BEFORE: Add up to 2 cards from your discard pile to your Gauge.
HIT: +1 Power for each card in your Gauge.
BEFORE: You may discard any number of cards from your hand. Draw that many +1.
HIT: Gain 3 life. Add the top 3 cards of your deck to your Gauge.
description: 由Undertale的Toby Fox為Marine作曲的原創歌曲。作為Ultra卡，此牌象徵她職業生涯的重大成就——首位登上FNS歌謡祭的VTuber以及與國際知名創作者的合作。效果圍繞寶藏（Gauge）與生命力展開，是牌組的核心旗艦卡。

name: Marine Set Sail!!

boost.name: Ahoy!! You're All Pirates
effect: NOW: Exceed. +2 Power.
If you are in Exceed Mode, +2 Speed and Stun Immunity.
BEFORE: Close 3. Draw 2.
CRITICAL: +3 Power and Push 3.
HIT: Your opponent discards their hand and draws 3 cards.
description: 由田中公平（航海王等動畫作曲家）為Marine創作的出航主題曲，也是她1st Solo Live 'Ahoy!! You're All Pirates' 的名稱來源。作為最終Ultra卡，代表Marine夢想的起點——買海盜船、出航冒險。强大的壓制效果與強制對手重置手牌，象徵船長出航的威壓感。
